ana_marketing: Hey runtime — for the launch blog we need a compact benchmark sweep. Can the eng/runtime team run a small set of reproducible runs (gen + embeddings) across these variants: fp16, int8, int4-quant? Want cold/warm latencies, p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and a simple cost proxy (tokens * GPU-min). Also need sample payloads and the exact run command to include in a methods box. Target deadline EOD Tues. Thanks!
ryan_runtime: Can do. Which models + sequence lengths + batch/concurrency targets?
ana_marketing: Models: redwood-13b-instruct, lw-7b-open, bloomz-1b. Sequence lengths: 64, 512, 2048. Batches: 1 and 8. Concurrency: 1 and 4. For embeds: redwood-embed-512. Include a small sim-query set (~50). Will paste a few samples below.
devon_runtime: Heads-up: int4 quant on 2048 can trigger kernel fallbacks -> may end up running int8 for some ops. I’ll log fallbacks. Full sweep on one GPU ~6–8h; parallelize to cut time. Which infra to use (hosted/dedicated)?
nana_marketing: Use Dedicated (we have commit). Pool: launch-dedicated-small. Also record runtime commit SHA: abc123def. Please capture env: CUDA, driver, runtime version.
sasha_docs: For slides we need a CSV with columns: model, quant, seq_len, batch, concurrency, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_proxy, run_command, runtime_sha. Also a 2–3 line reproducibility note per run and the .jsonl sample input file.
benchbot: Scheduled run created: run_id=run-2387654321-1, queue position=2, ETA start 2026-03-24 03:00 UTC.
devon_runtime: Quick clarifications: warmup_tokens=512, warmup_requests=50 for warm runs. Use --quant-mode flags explicitly. I’ll run a small pilot tonight and post raw results.
nana_marketing: Sample prompts (paste for the sample .jsonl):
{"prompt":"Summarize the differences between attention and sparse attention in 3 bullets."}
{"prompt":"Write a friendly onboarding email for new users of our API (approx 100 tokens)."}
{"prompt":"Given a short product feature description, produce 5 concise marketing headlines."}
ryan_runtime: Q for embed throughput: do you want fixed input size or variable? I recommend fixed (128 tokens) so tokens/sec is comparable.
nana_marketing: Standardize embeds to 128 tokens. For gen runs use sampling temp=0.2 and set max_new_tokens to match the sequence scenario.
sasha_docs: Acceptance criteria note: any frontpage claim like "up to Xx cheaper" must be defensible using the median cost_proxy across the selected workloads. We'll draft wording after numbers land.
nana_marketing: Great — please ping once the pilot completes and post the pilot CSV + raw logs. :rocket:
